name: pdk-gonja-parse-speed-v5
instr:
Gonja is a Go template engine in `/app`. Loading templates with `gonja.FromString` becomes disproportionately expensive as the number of macros and tokens grows. Improve template loading speed for large macro-heavy templates, medium templates with non-ASCII text, and text-heavy templates with interpolations. A large macro template should load around an order of magnitude faster without noticeably slowing down the other kinds of input.

Keep existing exported APIs and template behavior intact, including rendered output, macro declarations, and parsed node structure. The whole repository must build and pass `go test -count=1 ./...` with the original tests restored. The environment is offline. Performance is compared against the original implementation on fresh templates of the kinds described above; each run must produce the same parsed and rendered results. Work in `/app` and use `go test -count=1 ./...` there to check correctness.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /app/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete - the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities.
